product.name: Northstar standard service platform
product.problem: 표준 HTTP 서비스의 생성·배포·운영이 ticket, 복사된 workflow와 불명확한 owner에 흩어져 있습니다.
product.outcome: 유효 staging 요청의 90%가 30분 안에 Ready하며 manual handoff와 orphan를 줄입니다.

controlPlane.idempotency: resource UID/generation and external operation IDs
controlPlane.readyEvidence: current generation, dependency conditions, observed artifact digest and external smoke
controlPlane.failureIsolation: poison resource becomes Blocked/Degraded without halting other tenant queues

delivery.artifactIdentity: immutable OCI digest tied to source and trusted build provenance
delivery.promotion: preview → staging → production using the same digest and environment gates
delivery.gitops: protected desired path, observed revision, drift/prune policy and break-glass close
delivery.rollback: previous release if data/config compatible; otherwise verified roll-forward

runtimeAndTenancy.profile: stateless-http/3.2.0 with readiness, identity, telemetry, resource and disruption contract
runtimeAndTenancy.data: managed capability owns persistence and retention outside Pod lifecycle

security.secret: reference and short-lived materialization; rotation/revocation evidence
security.exception: scope, risk owner, approver, expiry and compensating control
security.containment: pause promotion, revoke identity, quarantine artifact and inventory deployments

operations.journeySlo: staging environment Ready within 30 minutes for 90% of valid requests; production release observation 99.9%
operations.capacity: queue/cluster/provider/telemetry units with failure and upgrade headroom
operations.cost: tenant showback plus visible shared overhead and orphan scan
operations.upgrade: inventory, compatibility, preflight, canary/waves, abort/rollback and deprecation

scenarios.name: normal-create-again
scenarios.expectedState: existing operation returned, no duplicate resource

scenarios.name: credential-policy-failure
scenarios.event: issuer outage or bad policy rollout
scenarios.expectedState: bounded impact, no static fallback, rollback/repair

scenarios.name: service-retirement
scenarios.evidence: retirement audit, orphan and cost scan

uncheckedClaims.claim: Kubernetes network policy blocks all undesired paths
uncheckedClaims.whyUnchecked: core exercise has no real cluster/CNI

uncheckedClaims.claim: SLO target is achievable at production load
uncheckedClaims.whyUnchecked: no real traffic or capacity measurements

uncheckedClaims.claim: supply-chain controls resist a compromised builder
uncheckedClaims.nextValidation: threat exercise and isolated build/admission test
